title: Your GHL Leads: Captured, Followed Up and Assigned Automatically

sections.label: 1 - LEAD CAPTURE AND CONTACT MANAGEMENT
sections.note: Your parts one and two. A form fill becomes a tagged contact with its source saved.

sections.label: 2 - PIPELINE UPDATES
sections.note: Every new lead opens as an opportunity in the first stage of your pipeline.

sections.label: 3 - AUTOMATED FOLLOW-UPS
sections.note: The lead gets a text and an email within a minute, then the workflow waits one day.

sections.label: 4 - ACTIONS BASED ON LEAD ACTIVITY
sections.note: Your parts five to seven. A lead who replied or booked moves stage, and the owner gets a task and an alert.

sections.label: 5 - LEAD NURTURING
sections.note: A lead who went quiet gets a second text and an email, then the owner gets a call task.

nodes.label: 1 - A lead fills out your website form
2 - Tag the contact website-lead so you know where they came from
3 - Save Website form in the contact's Lead Source field
4 - Open the lead in your pipeline at the New Lead stage
nodes.notes: Pipeline updates happen on their own from here, nobody drags cards by hand.

nodes.label: 5 - Text the lead right away so they hear from you first

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, this is {{user.first_name}} with {{location.name}}. Thanks for reaching out, I got your request. What is the best time to give you a quick call today?

nodes.notes: Speed to lead: the text goes out within a minute of the form.

nodes.label: 6 - Email the lead the same details plus a link to book a call

params.subject: Got your request, {{contact.first_name}}

nodes.label: 7 - Wait one day to give the lead time to answer
8 - Did they reply or book a call?
nodes.notes: One check on lead activity: a reply or a booking tags them lead-engaged.

nodes.label: 8a - Move the opportunity to the Engaged stage
8b - Give the owner a task to follow up today

params.title: Follow up with {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} today
params.description: {{contact.first_name}} replied or booked a call. Check the conversation, confirm next steps and update the stage. Phone {{contact.phone}}, email {{contact.email}}.

nodes.notes: Task assignments go to whoever owns the contact, so your team always knows whose lead it is.

nodes.label: 8c - Text the owner that a hot lead is waiting

params.to: the contact's assigned user, and if none is assigned, all users
params.message: Hot lead: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} replied or booked a call. Task is in GHL. {{contact.phone}}

nodes.label: 8d - Send a second text to a lead who has not answered yet

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, {{user.first_name}} again from {{location.name}}. Just checking you saw my message about your request. Reply here or pick a time that works: {{custom_values.booking_link}}

nodes.label: 8e - Wait two more days before the next follow-up
8f - Email a short check-in that keeps the door open

params.subject: Still want help with your request?

nodes.label: 8g - Give the owner a task to call the lead who went quiet

params.title: Call {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}, no reply yet
params.description: {{contact.first_name}} got two texts and two emails with no reply. Give them one call and note the outcome.

output_sample.task: Follow up with Jordan Reyes today
